name: counterspell
lore:
### The Art of the Severed Thread: Counterspell

To the layman, magic is a roar; to the scholar, it is a delicate symphony. *Counterspell* is the sudden, jarring silence. It manifests not as a bolt, but as a crystalline fracture in the air—a flash of violet static where an incantation was meant to bloom.

Manipulating the Weave in this manner requires a violent intuition. You do not weave new patterns; you seize existing ones. To the caster, it feels like catching a falling silk thread mid-snap—a sharp, cold jolt that grounds an opponent’s surging power back into the ether before it can manifest.

Legend attributes its codification to the Silent Sibyl of Aethelgard. Faced with a sorcerer-king’s world-ending pyre, she did not meet fire with ice. Instead, she simply reached out and "pinched" the air, snuffing his grand inferno as one might a common candle wick.

*Note to the Wise:* To deny the Weave is to court its fickle wrath. Use this disruption only when the alternative is certain doom, for the magic you unmake does not simply vanish—it waits.
